findings.text: follow-on: the preflight hands effective_block a multi-row _lift_history while the routing path passes at most one reading row (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:325), so a reset-anchored lift can end on one path and not the other.
follow-on: report["policy"] stays the configured block while the per-backend verdicts now carry a per-group judged block, so under a lift the report's own policy and its verdicts disagree.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 8ef0fdc744d6542d013a9799331464535ceea199; the single commit 687da66054858ea2061cf94eda38ee5a4bbdbe7c changes three files, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py and its cases for the 95% codex-sub reading under a global uncapped lift, session scoping, cache refresh and review-exclusion parity; all four landed and their result is recorded in the manifest.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that budget.preflight judge each backend against the block its group's governing lift puts in force; reckon/budget.py:1652 resolves it through budget_group.effective_block, the same function routing calls.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the importer gate ran 642 passed at base and 646 at head, the negative control ran 3 failed and 1 passed, and it names its logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/budget.py, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, tests/test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py and the unused fragment and figure paths; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: the negative control reinstated the configured-block defect and three cases in tests/test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py reddened with EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py:84 asserts effective_ceiling_pct 100 after a grant, matching the done_when's stated figure, and the manifest records the run.
justifications.fit: reckon/budget.py:1661 composes {**config, "budget": block} inline, mirroring the private reckon/crew/routing.py:396 helper rather than sharing it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:1652 hands each backend the budget_group.effective_block result for its group, so a lift and the review-exclusion rule both reach the verdict.
justifications.reuse: the change calls the existing budget_group.effective_block owner at reckon/budget.py:1652 and adds no new definition, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: every hunk in 687da66054858ea2061cf94eda38ee5a4bbdbe7c lands in reckon/budget.py, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py and the new test file, the declared write paths.
